parts.note: pal is an informal word for a mate or friend
a shot is an attempt, a try

explanation.surface: A friend's attempt at something was a poor effort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shot' looks like an anagram signal for 'mate', but it is simply a synonym for an attempt.
explanation.definitionFit: Paltry and poor are synonyms describing something meagre or worthless.

clue.text: Riddle of spades found on coach

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits on top of the second, so spades comes above coach

parts.note: S is the card-suit abbreviation for spades
a trainer is a sports coach

explanation.surface: A card-game puzzle involving spades turns up on a bus trip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Riddle' here is not a puzzle but a coarse sieve, and to riddle is to sift.
explanation.definitionFit: A riddle is a large sieve for soil or gravel, so a sieving device is a fair synonym.

parts.note: to baby someone is to spoil them, so 'baby's' is read as 'spoils'
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: An infant has left behind a soaked blanket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Baby's' reads as a noun with a possessive, but it is the verb 'babies', meaning spoils.
explanation.definitionFit: A wet blanket is a person who dampens others' fun, exactly a killjoy.

clue.text: Part of the world captured by Vespasian

indicators.note: the letters are held within the Roman emperor's name, captured by it

explanation.surface: A region of the world was conquered by the Roman emperor Vespasian.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a continent, so a large part of the globe.

clue.text: Shabbily dressed in blue, close behind one

parts.note: blue and down both mean sad or depressed
a dog told to walk at heel keeps close behind its owner

explanation.surface: Someone scruffily turned out in blue clothes follows closely behind another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blue' looks like a colour of clothing in the scene, but it means low in spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: Down at heel is an idiom for scruffy and run-down, like worn-down shoe heels.

clue.text: Report made by knight put in holdall

indicators.note: the knight is placed inside the holdall

parts.note: a holdall is a kind of bag
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: A knight files a report and stuffs it into his bag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Report' is a loud noise, as of a gun, not a document.
explanation.definitionFit: A report is the sound of an explosion or gunshot, a loud noise.

parts.note: C is the card-suit abbreviation for clubs

indicators.note: the letters of 'later' are formed again in a new order

explanation.surface: Golf or social clubs later reorganise into a business syndicate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Clubs' looks like a group of organisations, but it is the card suit.
explanation.definitionFit: A cartel is a combination of businesses fixing prices, a kind of syndicate.

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
a league is a band or association of people

explanation.surface: A popular music band is collaborating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'band' suggests a group of musicians, but here it is an alliance.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in league is an idiom for collaborating, usually conspiratorially.

clue.text: Article with piece of advice about course of hors d'oeuvres

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
a tip is a helpful hint
as to means concerning or about

explanation.surface: A piece written with advice about serving starters.
explanation.definitionFit: Antipasto is the Italian starter course of cold meats and olives, the hors d'oeuvres.

parts.note: an aga is a Turkish military commander
a candidate who is elected is in

explanation.surface: Yet another military leader has been voted in.
explanation.walkthrough: An AGA was a commander in the Ottoman Empire.
explanation.definitionFit: Again can mean another time over, as in 'the same again' for another one.

indicators.note: the letters of 'a strain' are suffering, knocked out of shape

explanation.surface: An empress is under strain and suffering.
explanation.definitionFit: A tsarina was the wife of a tsar or a ruling Russian empress.

clue.text: Frilly thing that is put on?

definitions.text: Frilly thing that is put on?

indicators.note: frilly suggests something ruffled and fussed about, so the letters are ruffled into a new order

parts.note: ie is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A frilly item of clothing that one puts on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frilly' looks like a description of lace but stirs THING into NIGHT; the whole clue then describes the garment itself, flagged by the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a woman's nightdress, often frilly, put on for bed.
The word means both a craving and the Japanese unit of currency.

clue.text: Shah flew — got abroad to put in an appearance

indicators.note: abroad means scattered widely, so the letters are spread out anew

explanation.surface: The Shah flew overseas to make an appearance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abroad' looks like travel, but it means all over the place, shuffling SHAH FLEW and GOT.
explanation.definitionFit: To show the flag is an idiom for making a token appearance at an event.

parts.note: over means ended or finished
a charge is an attack

explanation.surface: A completed assault leaves a chess rook exposed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rook' is not the chess piece but a verb meaning to swindle.
explanation.definitionFit: To rook someone is to cheat them, especially by charging too much.

clue.text: Each alternate model taken up here, nearly always to the top

indicators.note: in a down clue the always word is placed at the top

parts.note: ever means always

indicators.note: in a down clue going up means the word is read backwards

parts.note: a toy can be a model

indicators.note: nearly means one letter short of the full word

parts.note: taken as written, then shortened

explanation.surface: A model is lifted up here, nearly always all the way to the top.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken up' turns TOY into YOT; 'nearly' trims HERE to HER; 'to the top' puts EVER first.
explanation.definitionFit: Every other means alternate ones, skipping each second one.

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
to go is to leave

explanation.surface: Load up the vehicle and set off.
explanation.definitionFit: Cargo is goods carried, a load or freight.

parts.note: a cap is a top or lid
horror and fear are synonyms

explanation.surface: A first-rate English horror film.
explanation.walkthrough: 'horror' looks like the genre describing the film, but it is a synonym for dread.
explanation.definitionFit: Cape Fear is a thriller film, made in 1962 and remade in 1991.

indicators.note: not quite means the word falls a letter short of complete

parts.note: even means fair or balanced

explanation.surface: Is a girl being fair? Not entirely.
explanation.definitionFit: Eve is a girl's name, the first woman in Genesis.

indicators.note: the letters dance into a new order
the first letter of 'queens' is removed

explanation.surface: Follow the Dancing Queen? Not at first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not initially' drops the Q of QUEENS, leaving UEENS for 'dancing' to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: To ensue is to follow on as a consequence.

definitions.meaning: a children's hide-and-seek game where seekers pack into the hiding place

explanation.walkthrough: 'Game fish' reads as a sport fish like marlin, but it is two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a hide-and-seek party game and a small fish of the herring family.

clue.text: Pretty much in a way that is sensible

definitions.text: in a way that is sensible

explanation.definitionFit: The adverb means both virtually and in a sensible, workable way.

parts.note: greed and gluttony are synonyms

explanation.surface: The answer to the quiz, gluttony, was accepted.
explanation.definitionFit: Agreed can mean consented to or permitted.

indicators.note: the male comes after the sport

parts.note: RU is rugby union, a sport

explanation.surface: A strange man is pursuing a sport.
explanation.definitionFit: Rum is a British informal word for strange or peculiar.

clue.text: French painter capturing heart of Avignon — it has a certain attraction

indicators.note: the painter's name holds the next letter inside it

parts.note: Edouard Manet was a French Impressionist painter

indicators.note: the heart is the central letter of the word

explanation.surface: A French artist painting the centre of Avignon makes an appealing picture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heart of' picks the G at the centre of AVIGNON.
explanation.definitionFit: A magnet attracts iron, hence its attraction is literal.

clue.text: Intended to reach Greek character, left a prescription

parts.note: for means intended for, as in a present for someone
mu is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek man left a prescription intended to reach someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A formula is a set recipe or prescribed method, a prescription.

parts.note: un is French for a
to implement a plan is to do it

explanation.surface: Untangle a French tool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'implement' looks like a noun for a tool, but it is the verb to carry out.
explanation.definitionFit: To undo a knot is to loosen or untangle it.

definitions.meaning: sharp or hurtful, as a remark
a clipping, such as from a newspaper

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both wounding, as of a remark, and a clipped item such as a press clipping.

parts.note: old means aged, advanced in years

explanation.surface: An aged Conservative politician is unfriendly.
explanation.definitionFit: A cold manner is distant and lacking warmth.

clue.text: Change the last word, last in ballad

parts.note: amen is the word said at the end of a prayer

indicators.note: the final letter of the word ballad

explanation.surface: Revise the final word, the closing line of a ballad.
explanation.definitionFit: To amend is to alter or revise.

clue.text: Good early look at Bond film

parts.note: olden means of former times, early
to eye is to look at

explanation.surface: A good preview of a James Bond film.
explanation.definitionFit: GoldenEye is the 1995 James Bond film starring Pierce Brosnan.
